{{Top|leg}}
'''Ilsa Shuverin''' was an individual who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Shuverin was present on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:P">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Palo|Naboo}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer working for [[Palo/Legends|Palo]],<ref name="SWG:P" /> a [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]],<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> defended Ilsa Shuverin who was attacked by a [[flewt]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]].<ref name="SWG:P" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Ilsa Shuverin]]
Ilsa Shuverin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:P" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Because Ilsa Shuverin spawned under the generic "commoner" template, their [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Gender/Legends|gender]] and appearance were randomized under one of a 120 possible depictions during each server reset.<ref name="SWG:P" />

Ilsa Shuverin was involved in the first quest given by Palo on Naboo. However, these quests were bugged and lacked any text dialogue strings, rendering it impossible to have derived much context from them.<ref name="SWG:P" /><ref name="NabooMap">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=jedi&message.id=55618.html|text=Attach to the Labeled Naboo Map: All Static missions for Naboo}} {{C|"username/password: swganh"}}</ref> Palo and related characters such as Ilsa Shuverin were eventually removed from the game by its developers relatively early in the game's lifespan.
